recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞圖：CD45/SSC 圖分出 CD45 亮的淋巴球群與 CD45 較暗的母細胞群；淋巴球中的 B 細胞為 CD5+ 且 CD20 偏弱（CLL 表型），母細胞群則 CD34+、CD117+、CD33+、CD13-，代表同時存在的髓系母細胞。
features: CD45 vs SSC: lymphocyte gate (bright CD45, low SSC) and a distinct CD45-dim, low-SSC blast gate
Lymphocyte gate: CD19+ B cells separated from CD3+ T cells
Gated B cells: uniformly CD5-positive with dim CD20
Gated blasts: CD34-positive with dim to moderate CD117
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show two abnormal populations. In the lymphocyte gate, CD19+ B cells are uniformly CD5-positive with dim CD20, a pattern typical of chronic lymphocytic leukemia (the report adds CD43+, CD81-negative and dim lambda restriction). A separate CD45-dim, low side-scatter blast population expresses CD34, dim CD117 and CD33 without CD13, consistent with myeloblasts. Interpreted with the morphology, karyotype and NGS results, the findings support concurrent CLL and a therapy-related high-grade myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: MCL is also CD5+ but has brighter CD20 and surface light chain, is usually CD23-negative/CD200-negative, and carries cyclin D1/CCND1 rearrangement.
Hematogones form a continuous CD34/CD10/CD19 maturation spectrum rather than a discrete CD34+/CD117+/CD33+ myeloid blast cluster lacking CD19.
